Figure 1b Oncoprint of somatic mutations in head and neck cancers from TCGA, stratified by HPV status. In HPV-positive tumors, recurrent somatic mutations are few, with only PIK3CA hotspot mutations in 36% of cases.




Figure 1c Comparison of commercially available targeted liquid biopsy assays, showing limited variant capture in HPV-positive head and neck cancers based on TCGA mutation profiles.
